blind.description: A classical or fantasy-style stone bench with an aged, weathered sandstone look and greenish moss patches. It consists of a long rectangular slab seat flanked by scroll-shaped volute armrests at each end, supported from beneath by three carved pedestal legs (one at each end and one in the center). All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without gaps, floating elements, or unnatural deformations.
blind.from_above: A long rectangular stone slab with cylindrical scroll details at both ends, displaying mossy green and beige stone texturing.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 to 2 feet tall (around knee height, roughly 1/3 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 5 to 6 feet long (approximately the same as the figure's height).
